_why: Transposed Census XLSX stand-in for the legacy loadProfiles() branch table. Row 1 is the header (col 0 = 'Neighbourhood Name', cols 1-3 = neighbourhood names); row 2 is the format-2 ID row ('Neighbourhood Number') whose numeric cells supply the neighbourhood_id per column. Every subsequent row is [characteristic, Alpha, Beta, Gamma] with characteristic strings copied verbatim from the script's INCOME_CHARACTERISTICS keys, PCT_CHARACTERISTIC, CONSTRUCTION_PERIODS and the exact-match / startsWith branches in loadProfiles(). Value cells pin parseNumeric() edge cases: 100000.4 rounds, the comma string '95,000.6' is comma-cleaned, the suppression tokens 'x' and '...' parse to null (absent), and 0 is a real zero distinct from absent. SPEC LINK: docs/specs/01-pipeline/57_source_neighbourhoods.md, docs/specs/01-pipeline/123_step_opt_assessment_validation.md §4.5 (legacy oracle, not source-text).
